name: Hotel Thierseerhof
beschreibung: The Hotel Thierseerhof is located directly on the shore of Lake Thiersee in the municipality of Thiersee of the same name. The quiet lakeside location with views of the surrounding mountains shapes the atmosphere of the family-run house. Typical amenities include the hotel's own lake access with swimming area and sunbathing lawn, as well as a wellness area. The rooms are predominantly equipped with a balcony and lake view. The restaurant serves Tiroler home-style cooking and international dishes. Guests use their stay for hikes in the Kaisergebirge or excursions to Kufstein.
